sentences.en: Shame on you for getting so flustered. You looked ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 你这么手忙脚乱真丢人。你看起来好可笑。

sentences.en: He keeps a straight face while telling a ridiculous story.
sentences.zh: 他讲一个荒谬的故事时还一本正经。

sentences.en: This is the most ridiculous thing I have ever heard.
sentences.zh: 这是我听过的最荒谬的事情。

senses.zh: 可笑的，荒谬的,荒唐的，愚蠢的,胡枝扯叶
